changes.reason: 'Бару уақыты' literally means 'time of arrival/visit'. The field describes how long a visit takes (Finnish 'Vierailuaika' = time needed), so 'Қажетті уақыт' (required time) is more accurate.
'Күрделілік' means 'complexity'. Standard Kazakh for hiking/visit difficulty is 'Қиындық'.
'Бағасы' = 'its price'. The field is a tier label (low/mid/high), so 'Баға деңгейі' (price level) is more accurate.
'Жоба' more commonly means 'project'. 'Қаралама' is the standard Kazakh term for 'draft' (unfinished document/entry).
'Ұшулар' = 'flights' as actions. In a budget context the category is air tickets — 'Әуе билеттері' is the standard budgeting term.
'Тұру' = 'staying/living' (verbal noun). For a budget category label, 'Тұрғын-жай' (accommodation) is the conventional noun.
'Тұрғын үй' means 'residential housing'. A trip-pin labeled 'hotel' should be 'Қонақ үй' (hotel/guesthouse).
'Жүру' alone means 'to walk/go' and is ambiguous as a section header. 'Жол жүру' (travelling/transport) reads as a proper section title in itinerary.
Consistency with budget.categoryLodging change; 'lodging tip' is more naturally 'Тұрғын-жай кеңесі'.
Other transport modes in this block are nouns (Пойыз/Көлік/Автобус/Такси). 'Ұшу' is the verb 'to fly'; switched to the noun 'Ұшақ' (airplane) for consistency.
'Жерінде' (= 'in its place') is an awkward calque from Russian 'на месте'. 'Жеткен соң' (after arriving) is clearer Kazakh for Finnish 'paikan päällä' / 'on arrival'.
The original puts 'орын' in accusative without a clear subject; passive 'Орын анықталуда' (the location is being determined) is grammatically clean.

changes.before: Орынды анықтау уақыты өтті — қайталап көріңіз
changes.after: Орын анықтау уақыты өтіп кетті — қайталап көріңіз
changes.reason: Removed unnecessary accusative on 'орын' (gerund noun phrase doesn't need it) and used 'өтіп кетті' which reads more naturally for a timeout event.
'Әбден' means 'completely/utterly' and reads as final/exaggerated. 'Едәуір' (considerably/quite) matches Finnish 'jo iso' (already big) more accurately.
Accusative case fix — direct object of 'тазарту' takes the accusative ending '-тті', not '-і'.
Button labels prefer concise nouns. 'Бағыттау' = 'to direct/orient' is verbose for a navigation button; the noun 'Бағыт' (direction/route) reads tighter.

changes.before: Бұл нысандар енді қолжетімсіз. /көрнекті жерлер бетінен жаңасын қосуға болады.
changes.after: Бұл нысандар енді қолжетімсіз. Көрнекті жерлер бетінен жаңасын қосуға болады.
changes.reason: The original referenced '/көрнекті жерлер' as a slug, but per project policy URL slugs are Finnish ('/nahtavyydet'). Removed the leading slash so the text reads as a page name rather than an invalid URL.
Subtitle was tautological (repeating the region name 'Астана'). Other locales say 'capital' (Pääkaupunki / The capital / Столица). 'Елорда' is the standard Kazakh word for 'capital city'.

uncertain.note: Russian/English calque ('command palette'). A purer Kazakh phrasing would be 'Бұйрық тақтасы' but the borrowed term is widely understood in tech UI contexts; left as-is.
Used adverbially ('on foot') alongside noun transport modes (Ұшақ/Пойыз/Көлік). Could be 'Жаяулап' but 'Жаяу' is the standard short label and reads naturally.

'Нативті' is a borrowed adjective from English/Russian. Could be replaced with 'тікелей' (directly) but the technical register matches usage in the rest of the file.
Standard for working hours. Acceptable across both sight detail and car rental contexts.
